# Introduction

Greydwarfs are aggressive creatures found in Black Forests. They are mossy tree-like beings and are twice as strong as their Greyling counterparts.

## Drops

• Item: Greydwarf eye | 0 Star: 50% | 1 Star: 2 | 2 Star: 4

• Item: Greydwarf trophy | 0 Star: 5% | 1 Star: 5% | 2 Star: 5%

• Item: Resin | 0 Star: 1 | 1 Star: 2 | 2 Star: 4

• Item: Stone | 0 Star: 1 | 1 Star: 2 | 2 Star: 4

• Item: Wood | 0 Star: 1 | 1 Star: 2 | 2 Star: 4

## Spawning

• Type: Anywhere in Black Forest during the daytime | Limit: 3 | Frequency: Common | Stars: Yes

• Type: Anywhere in Black Forest during the nighttime, despawn at dawn | Limit: 6 | Frequency: Very common | Stars: Yes

• Type: Anywhere in forests of Meadows during the nighttime after defeating Eikthyr, despawn at dawn | Limit: 1 | Frequency: Common | Stars: No

• Type: Anywhere in clearings of Meadows during the nighttime after defeating Eikthyr, despawn at dawn | Limit: 2 | Frequency: Common | Stars: No

• Type: Multiple spawn points near abandoned structures in Black Forest | Limit: - | Frequency: One time | Stars: Yes

• Type: From Greydwarf nests in Black Forest | Limit: 3 | Frequency: 12 seconds | Stars: Yes

• Type: During "The forest is moving..." event before defeating The Elder | Limit: 6 | Frequency: Very common | Stars: No

### Attack

Swings their hand sideways in a 1.7-meter 90-degree horizontal arc to scratch the player (14 Slash damage). This attack can be used every 2 seconds when within 1.2 meters of a player.

### Throw

Winds their arm back before swinging forward to throw a rock (10 Blunt damage). The rock travels at 12 meters per second for up to 4 seconds before despawning and has a spread of 5 degrees. This attack can be used every 8 seconds when within 5–15 meters of a player.

## Notes

• The word Greydwarf is derived from Astrid Lindgren's tale Ronja the Robber's daughter (Ronja Rövardotter). Originally named Grådvärgar, which is literally translated to Greydwarves. They are short creatures with grey fur who will attack a person when they sense the victim's fear. If you are emotionally aggressive then they will leave you be.
